title: Matthew Stafford’s MVP season was fueled by massive ‘luck cushion’ — what it means for 2026

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matthew Stafford’s MVP season was fueled by massive ‘luck cushion’ — what it means for 2026
sources.description: Matthew Stafford’s brilliant 2025 campaign secured him his first MVP award and pushed the Los Angeles Rams back into the Super Bowl conversation, but a new study from Pro Football Focus suggests the veteran quarterback may have been riding the NFL’s biggest wave of turnover luck.
